summary: Great post on the #IndieWeb WordPress community and plugins. You may want to make a note that mf2 plugin is not supported. Microformats work best with native themes. If people want to use the mf2 plugin they should first search their theme for older microformats and delete them. The plugin is a great idea but needs a new mantainer. Interested?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Great post on the #IndieWeb WordPress community and plugins.

You may want to make a note that mf2 plugin is not supported. Microformats work best with native themes.

If people want to use the mf2 plugin they should first search their theme for older microformats and delete them.

The plugin is a great idea but needs a new mantainer. Interested?
